title: Envelope
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Envelope body -->
  <rect x="12" y="28" width="76" height="52" rx="6" fill="#FFD966" stroke="#FFC233" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Envelope flap (triangle) -->
  <polygon points="12,28 50,58 88,28" fill="#FFE699" stroke="#FFC233" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  
  <!-- Inner flap triangle shading -->
  <polygon points="12,28 50,58 88,28" fill="#FFE699" opacity="0.5"/>
  
  <!-- Bottom fold lines -->
  <polygon points="50,58 12,80 12,74" fill="#F0C040" opacity="0.7"/>
  <polygon points="50,58 88,80 88,74" fill="#F0C040" opacity="0.7"/>
  
  <!-- Bottom right edge highlight -->
  <line x1="50" y1="58" x2="12" y2="80" stroke="#FFC233" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.5"/>
  
  <!-- Cute wax seal / heart on envelope -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="68" r="8" fill="#FF5E5E" stroke="#FF3B3B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="68" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.4"/>
  <path d="M50 64 L52 67 L56 67 L53 69 L54 73 L50 71 L46 73 L47 69 L44 67 L48 67 Z" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.8" transform="scale(0.6) translate(33,44)"/>
  
  <!-- Top flap highlight -->
  <polygon points="15,30 50,56 85,30" fill="none" stroke="#FFF2B2" stroke-width="1.2" opacity="0.6"/>
  
  <!-- Cute stamp in corner -->
  <rect x="68" y="32" width="14" height="16" rx="1.5" fill="#7ED8F7" stroke="#5BC4E8" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <rect x="70" y="34" width="10" height="12" fill="#B8EAFE"/>
  <circle cx="75" cy="40" r="2.5" fill="#FF9E5E"/>
  
  <!-- Sparkle accents -->
  <circle cx="20" cy="22" r="1.5" fill="#FFE699"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="20" r="1.2" fill="#FFE699"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="85" r="1.3" fill="#FFE699"/>
  <circle cx="74" cy="86" r="1.5" fill="#FFE699"/>
</svg>
